name: "Roll 'n' Bake" Doner Kebab Wraps with Shirazi Cucumber-Tomato Salad & Garlic Tahini Sauce

instructions.primary_message: Peel, halve, and coarsely grate onion; peel and mince garlic. Place both in a food processor along with beef, chicken, and spices. Blend on high, scraping down the sides of the processor as needed, until meat is smooth and paste-like, 30-60 seconds.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium white onion
garlic
227 g lean ground beef
227 g ground chicken
2 tsp paprika
1 tsp fennel seeds
1 tsp cumin, ground
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
1 tsp coriander, ground

instructions.primary_message: Cut four 11 x 15-inch rectangles of parchment paper.

Transfer half of the meat mixture to one sheet of parchment. Using damp hands (keep a bowl of water nearby), roughly press the meat out across the parchment. Cover the meat with a second sheet of parchment, then gently roll the top sheet with a rolling pin to smooth out the meat to the edges. Repeat with remaining parchment and meat mixture.

Working one at a time, carefully unpeel the top sheet from the flattened meat mixture. Starting from the short side, fold the parchment over the meat, about 2 inches at a time, until you have a flat rope shape. Transfer both rolls to a large baking sheet pan.
Place baking sheet in the oven and bake, flipping rolls halfway, until meat is cooked through, 20-30 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
½ English cucumber
1 tomato
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemon into a small bowl. Add oil, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and small dice cucumber. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Small dice tomato. Add to the bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl, stir to combine the salad, and set aside.
Peel and mince additional garlic. Place in another small bowl along with yogurt, tahini, water, honey, salt, and pepper, then whisk to combine the garlic-tahini sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
garlic
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp tahini
½ tsp honey
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the meat is done, remove from the oven. Set aside to cool slightly, 5 minutes.
Transfer cooled meat-parchment rolls to a cutting board, then carefully unwrap. Roughly chop or tear meat into strips.
To assemble, fill pita breads with meat, salad, and lettuce, then drizzle with garlic-tahini sauce.
Divide between plates and serve with hot sauce on the side. Enjoy!
